scores.note: A few brass instruments for one circle of users; a handier calculating form, with no known line of successors resting on this design.
Base-ten tables became the working form for calculators in several professions and all later tables followed them; a step within logarithms, so total implies tier 2, not 1.
Navigators and surveyors used the rule for generations; it made logarithmic work quicker, and the whole slide-rule line grew from its scale.
Official Tang teaching notes read by East Asian mathematical students; they clarify an existing text and little later work rests on them, implying tier 3 rather than 2.
Studied by East Asian mathematicians for a millennium; it justified and extended known procedures and later commentary grew from it. Total implies tier 2, not the reviewed 1.

Calculating professions across many societies reorganised computation around it; astronomy, navigation, engineering and analysis rested on it. Reach stays professional, so total 6 implies tier 1, not 0.
The canon of procedures for officials and calculators across East Asia; it organised mathematical practice and a whole commentary tradition grew from it.
Sliding replaced dividers, a clear convenience; engineers used its descendants for three centuries and the slide-rule line grew from it. Total implies tier 2, not 1.
Worked examples that made one textbook easier for Maghribi students; a teaching aid within one school tradition with no known successors.
Brought written place-value reckoning to the Islamic world and, through Latin versions, Europe; a new way to calculate from which the algorism tradition grew.
A neater way to find common denominators, used by Maghribi inheritance calculators; a refinement of existing practice with no later work known to rest on it.
A description of the dust-board practice already in regional use; nothing new was changed by this account, and the paper methods are its one successor.
Keeping the working visible on paper was a clear gain for regional calculators; direct descent of later paper arithmetic from this text is thin.
Gave mathematicians in India and later readers a new arithmetic of zero and negative quantities, from which a line of algebra grew; reach stays within the profession.
One merchant's son taught an existing method in one port; its single known successor is Liber abaci. Total implies tier 3 rather than the reviewed 2.
Scored as the dated inscriptions with the circular sign, regional witnesses of a notation already in use; the place-value system itself would score far higher.
A procedure used by mathematicians across several societies; a modest gain in what they could do, but number theory grew on it. Total implies tier 2, not 1.
A compact rule book taught across the Maghrib for generations; it ordered existing arithmetic and drew a handful of commentaries.
One of several Latin texts giving scholars the new reckoning; a thinly transmitted version with a few successors in the algorism tradition.
A fuller Latin exposition for the same scholarly readership; it rearranged known methods and no distinct later line is known to rest on it.
Italian and then European merchants reorganised commercial reckoning around written place-value arithmetic; the abbacus school tradition grew from it.
One school tablet showing a precise root value known to scribes; the value recurs later but little rests on it. Total implies tier 3, not 2.
One trainee's copy of a standard table: a witness to schooling, not a change in what anyone could do. Implies tier 3, not the reviewed 2.
A problem text of Egyptian scribal practice, copied from an older one; it served one society's administrators and its methods persisted in a few later texts.
Gave biochemists a new ability to size proteins and other large molecules; a profession-wide method from which much of macromolecular science grew.
Made an existing measurement quick and routine in laboratories and opened the line of electronic chemical instruments. Total implies tier 2, not the reviewed 1.
One adapted apparatus used by one experimenter; it sharpened a known question and Joule's work followed. Total implies tier 3 rather than the reviewed 2.
Made recording the heart's electrical activity practical, a new clinical ability used by medicine worldwide; electrocardiography grew from it.
One product model that let electronics engineers read frequency directly; faster than comparison methods, with later counters as its successors. Implies tier 2, not 1.
One laboratory's experiment, but separating the A and B forms made DNA's structure determinable and the double helix rested on it. Total implies tier 2, not 1.
One apparatus in one experimenter's hands; a far more exact measurement, with the refined heat equivalent recorded separately. Total implies tier 3, not 2.
The heat-stable enzyme made DNA copying routine; diagnostics, forensics, genomics and ancient-DNA work all stand on it, and testing reached populations in many countries.
One microscopist's trial report to one society; it assessed new lenses and changed nothing later work is known to rest on.
A clear optical improvement used by microscopists in several countries, copied by a few other makers.
The first documented working telescope; seamen, soldiers and astronomers across Europe gained distant sight, and telescopic astronomy grew from it.
Raised the spyglass to an astronomical instrument; astronomers across Europe reorganised observation around it and telescopic astronomy followed.
One small instrument, but the first working reflector; astronomers later relied on its descendants and the reflector line grew from it. Total implies tier 2, not 1.
One London maker's own version of a lens type just introduced elsewhere; better for its few buyers, with nothing later known to rest on it.
Gave scientists and industry a new way to see surfaces in fine detail; used across many laboratories, with a line of surface analysis built on it.
Let researchers see far below the limit of light; used across biology and materials science, and electron microscopy grew from it as a field.
One catalogue lens of an older series, soon withdrawn; a variant of existing objectives on which nothing later is known to rest.
Better colour correction for microscopists everywhere; apochromats became the standard for fine work and a line of optics followed. Total implies tier 2, not 1.
One research team's buoy deployments; they made traditional wave knowledge measurable and one follow-up study rests on them.
One watch and its copy; they proved longitude by timekeeper was possible, but later chronometers took other designs, so direct successors are few.
A proposed scale nobody adopted as written, yet the idea of substance-free temperature led to the absolute scale. Total implies tier 2, not the reviewed 1.
Changed what educated societies took the world to be; later astronomy and physics over many generations stood on a moving Earth.
One observing campaign whose result astronomers everywhere took up: bodies circling another planet, later used for longitude and for measuring light's speed.
Astronomers rebuilt planetary prediction on it, and gravitation and celestial mechanics rested on it; reach stays professional, so total 6 implies tier 1, not 0.
Showed astronomers the Moon is a rugged body like Earth, new knowledge with lunar mapping as its successor. Total implies tier 2, not the reviewed 1.
Changed the understanding of space and time; particle physics, nuclear physics, field theory and cosmology stand on it, though mainly physicists work with it.
The first complete quantum mechanics changed the understanding of matter; atomic, chemical and solid-state physics rest on it. Reach counts this formulation's users, physicists.
